body:
And honestly? We don't blame her ONE BIT. | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/143725141/661178830/-785282667?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4N2U3YjcxYy00NmU0LWYxMTEtOTFmMy0wMDBkM2E1MzM5NzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=KerTnObSAF9-Vq-TWTNA61cru2rqhHXhGh6zcAw914c=)

Peter, **Well, Becca is FURIOUS. And frankly, we don't blame her one bit.** Something Donald Trump said about Vladimir Putin has been weighing pretty heavily on her mind. And when she headed out for her morning walk in D.C. this morning, she was pretty fired up about it. And honestly?**We think you should be, too.** Because while the people of Ukraine continue fighting for their freedom, our NATO allies worry about their security, and countries across Europe fear what Russia might do next, Donald Trump is out here greeting Vladimir Putin with a smile and calling him... **HIS FRIEND.** _Are you KIDDING us right now?!_ The President of the United States is cozying up to a brutal dictator who has spent years trying to undermine democracy and threaten our allies. And somehow, we're all supposed to act like this is normal? **Absolutely. Freaking. NOT.** Becca didn't go to Congress to sit quietly while Donald Trump makes a mockery of American leadership on the world stage. And she sure as heck isn't going to start now. **[HELL NO. WE'RE FIGHTING BACK!](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/143725142/661178831/-744878409?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS84MTM0MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4N2U3YjcxYy00NmU0LWYxMTEtOTFmMy0wMDBkM2E1MzM5NzgiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=KerTnObSAF9-Vq-TWTNA61cru2rqhHXhGh6zcAw914c=)** Like Becca said, **“Trump is Putin's puppet. It's that simple. He is Putin's puppet, and we need to push back.”** And she's right. We've spent years watching Trump praise dictators, attack our democratic institutions, and treat America's closest allies like they're the enemy. **And every single time, the question is the same: How much more of this are we supposed to take?** Well, Becca has an answer. **We're going to keep speaking out. We're going to keep holding Trump accountable. And we're going to keep fighting like hell for the democracy and freedoms we believe in.** Because the stakes are too high, and the consequences of staying silent are too serious. The truth is Becca is heading into the new Congress ready to make some serious noise. And with Democrats preparing to take back the House majority, we finally have an opportunity to put some real muscle behind that fight. **We need every single person who believes in this fight standing alongside us.** **[I'M WITH BECCA. name: Eileen for Colorado
subject: Thank You, and Some Updates from Team Eileen
body:
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | [|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/fMhsWYmD3kT?e=1c5f08419c&c2id=9f711ebcee4618a2092828a4c98e410a)
| | | | | | | | | | | | | | | |

Hi Everyone,
What a whirlwind the last few weeks have been!
From election night, to waiting for the final results, to different news outlets calling the race on different days, to heading to Washington for New Member Orientation — it’s been a remarkable couple of weeks, to say the least.
But amid all the excitement and chaos, one thing hasn’t changed: We know exactly who got us here.
This campaign was built by the incredible volunteers, staff, and supporters who gave so much of themselves over the last 17 months. You knocked doors, made calls, hosted events, talked to your neighbors, and showed up again and again. You believed in Eileen and in what we could accomplish together, even when the odds seemed stacked against us.
And now, because of you, Colorado’s 4th Congressional District has a new representative heading to Washington.
We’re still working through a lot of the logistics of this transition, but I wanted to share a couple of updates and make sure you know how much you remain a part of this team.
_**Celebrating Together**_
We’re already working on plans for two opportunities to celebrate this historic victory together:
**> Inauguration Day in Washington, D.C.:** The house gallery is closed during swearing in and each newly elected official only received two tickets (incredibly tough for moms of five!). There will be limited seating to watch the swearing in on C-SPAN in Eileen’s new office. Outside of that, we’re planning a celebration on January 3 later in the day, and everyone who helped make this possible will be invited!
**> Volunteer Appreciation Celebration in Colorado: **We’re also planning a celebration back home in Colorado in January so we can celebrate with the people and communities who made this victory possible.
We hope to have more details to share in early December. We want to make sure everyone has an opportunity to be part of this moment.
_**Joining the Congressional Team**_
I also know many of you have asked about opportunities to work in Eileen’s congressional office. We’re currently focused on filling some key senior staff positions and building a team that can hit the ground running in January.
One of our biggest priorities is assembling an exceptional district staff. We’re looking for people who care deeply about advocating for their communities and helping constituents navigate federal agencies — whether that’s a veteran in need of assistance with a VA claim, someone with a Social Security issue to resolve, or a delayed passport that needs to be tracked down.
If you or someone you know would be interested in serving the people of Colorado’s 4th District in this capacity, please reach out to me directly at taylor.gillespie@mail.house.gov.
And Finally, **Thank You.**
We know how much time, energy, and heart so many of you poured into this campaign, and we haven’t had nearly enough time to properly celebrate or thank everyone who made this possible.
As we transition from a campaign to a congressional office, the commitment that brought us together remains the same: showing up, listening, and fighting for the people of this district.
We’re incredibly grateful to each of you, and excited for what’s ahead.
Thank you for everything.
— Taylor
